relocation_strict.note: All intended aggregate references use lbl_8063C6B8 plus the retail addends, but the generated stream rematerializes that base after memcpy, shifting subsequent relocation offsets.

probes.source_shape: Initialize entry, loop index, and offset in the for initializer
Use direct lbl_8063C6B8 array plus canonical addends

divergence: Retail keeps lbl_8063C6B8 in r31 and emits addi r30,r31,0xDD0 immediately after memcpy, with r28 holding the u16 output offset. Canonical GC/1.3 redundantly rematerializes lbl_8063C6B8 using lis/addi after memcpy, assigns the output offset to r30 and entry pointer to r28, and consequently emits four extra bytes plus different address-folding and scheduling through the loop and tail calls. The historical interior-symbol source shape byte-matches only by relocating against lbl_8063CD18/lbl_8063D378/lbl_8063D400/lbl_8063D488, so it is not a relocation-strict solution and was not retained.
